character.description: left-facing playful pale-mint ghost moray boss head and short neck root

idle.action: left-facing two-frame ghost moray boss head loop at strict scale lock: keep the snout, eye, skull silhouette and right-edge neck root fixed; in frame 2 open the cheeky grin by one logical pixel, shift the four small teeth with the jaw and flex only the small attached dorsal fin by one pixel; head and neck only, no long body, tail, detached pieces, glow, bubbles or effects

style: native 40x32 hard-edged pixel art with large countable logical pixels, one-pixel dark teal outline and shared limited mint-seafoam-teal-ivory palette; friendly mischievous ghost moray, not a dinosaur
